primary_cohort: requests whose size regime is 20 MW or more (notebook 04's size_regime)
variant_rule: among the fixed candidates K0–K3 (LightGBM) and the K1/K2 logits, the one with the lowest multiclass log loss on 2016 entrants' project-years of 20 MW or more, fitted on entrants to 2015; refitted on entrants to 2016 for the test cohort

criteria.line: ≥ 20 MW cohort: v2 model vs fair baseline, Uno's C
criteria.model: v2 (lowest 2016 log loss on ≥ 20 MW rows)
criteria.rule: paired 95% interval entirely on the better side

criteria.line: ≥ 20 MW cohort: v2 model vs fair baseline, Brier
criteria.model: v2 (lowest 2016 log loss on ≥ 20 MW rows)
criteria.rule: paired 95% interval entirely on the better side

criteria.line: ≥ 20 MW cohort, 2018–2019 entrants, after level repair: calibration slope and intercept
criteria.rule: slope interval within 0.8–1.2 and intercept interval covering 0

criteria.line: Landmark model at +24 months and at IA executed vs the entry model, same risk set
criteria.rule: paired 95% interval entirely on the better side

criteria.line: Backtest: realised MW online by end-2024, model-chosen book vs fair-baseline book, same budget
criteria.rule: paired 95% interval entirely on the better side

criteria.line: Backtest: realised value of the model-chosen book vs the fair-baseline book, base value case
criteria.rule: paired 95% interval on the better side; low and high cases reported

criteria.line: Simulated book: the 5–95% band of expected MW online by 2024 covers the realised value
Leakage guard: no landmark feature dated after its landmark; landmark AUC ≤ leakage-ablation AUC
